articles.job_description: Apply now Job no: 596142 Contract type: Temporary Appointment Duty Station: Addis Ababa Level: NO-2 Location: Ethiopia Categories: Human Resources UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built: we offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. The People and Culture Officer position is based within the People and Culture Unit of UNICEF Ethiopia Country Office in Addis Ababa and supports the delivery of strategic and operational human resources services that enable UNICEF to achieve results for children across Ethiopia. The role contributes to attracting, developing, and retaining a high-performing and diverse workforce while ensuring the consistent application of UNICEF policies, procedures, and people management practices. Reporting to the People and Culture Manager, the incumbent provides research, analysis, and HR advisory support across a broad range of human resources functions, including talent acquisition, performance management, learning and development, workforce planning, and HR data analytics. The position works closely with managers and staff across the Country Office to strengthen people management practices, promote organizational effectiveness, and foster an inclusive and supportive workplace culture. The People and Culture Officer reports to the People and Culture Manager for close guidance, training and supervision. The Officer provides support to the supervisor and colleagues in the unit by executing HR services through applying knowledge of theoretical HR models, as well as understanding of organizational HR policies and procedures. Summary of key functions/accountabilities: Through research of policies and analysis of data, provide support to the HR Business Partner in advising their clients on HR-related needs and developing subsequent plans of action. Provide accurate and timely advice to clients on HR processes and policies, ensuring the highest level of client-orientation. Proactively advise clients on the resolution of human resources issues ensuring equitable and transparent solutions that protects both the staff and organizations interests in accordance with policies, regulations and procedures. Promote the organizational goals and targets for gender equity and cultural diversity . Liaise with the HQ Divisions, regional and country offices to support and contribute to corporate HR strategy formulation and global implementation. Provide feedback and make recommendations on the establishment and improvement of HR systems, policies and processes. Keep abreast, research, benchmark, and implement best and cutting edge practices in HR management and contribute to the development of global policies, procedures and introduce innovation through sharing of best practices and knowledge learned. 3. Support to Implementation of assigned Human Resources Services Provide support to various or one specific HR occupation (recruitment, job classification, career development, performance management, data analytics, learning & development etc.) to help their supervisors in implementing efficient client services that help either attract, retain and/or motivate staff of the highest caliber. When assigned casework in the relevant area on either a routine or non-routine basis, analyze and synthesize issues and problems, and interpret established formal guidelines to address and recommend solutions or further actions required. In collaboration with business owners, support the design and delivery of learning plans for staff. Contribute to the mapping of competencies for all staff included in the assigned client portfolio, assisting in the development of a comprehensive framework in support of the development of the talent pipeline. Research on efficient and cost-effective learning products which enable staff to develop their skills and competencies. Participate as a resource person in capacity building initiatives to enhance the competencies of clients/stakeholders. Provide orientation briefing to new staff. Collect, interpret and analyze HR data to help inform decision making on HR processes and strategies. Support the development and implementation of data collection systems to optimize data quality. Coordinate with country offices and partners to provide assistance in their HR information management. If you would like to know more about this position, please review the complete Job Description here: JD People and Culture Officer NO2 138075.pdf To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have… Education: Bachelor or equivalent (First Level University Degree) in Public Administration, International Relations, Sociology, Social Sciences or another related field is required. Work Experience: 2 years of relevant work experience in talent acquisition, performance management, learning and development, workforce planning, HR analytics, organizational development, employee relations, diversity and inclusion, HR Policy Implementation and Advisory Services. Skills: Experience is required in HR Regulations, Human Resources Management, Recruitment, Information Technology, Planning and Communication. Language Requirements: Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish) or a local language is an asset. Experience in the UN system, maternal and neonatal health, and humanitarian preparedness. Relevant experience at country level, particularly in development, fragile settings and humanitarian contexts. Knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish) or a local language is an asset. Experience in the UN system, maternal and neonatal health, and humanitarian preparedness. Relevant experience at country level, particularly in development, fragile settings and humanitarian contexts. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status. UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer a wide range of benefits to our staff, including paid parental leave, breastfeeding breaks and reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. UNICEF provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance. UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, fraud, corruption and other forms of serious misconduct.UNICEF is committed to promoting the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference, safeguarding and background verification checks. These checks may include verification of academic credentials and employment history, screening against relevant United Nations misconduct databases, and requests for misconduct disclosures from current and former employers, professional associations, other relevant organizations and participating organizations under inter-agency safeguarding initiatives, including the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS), where applicable.Appointment, selection and continued engagement are subject to the satisfactory completion of all required checks. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information and consent to enable UNICEF to undertake these checks.Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check, and selected candidates with disabilities may be requested to submit supporting documentation in relation to their disability confidentially. UNICEF appointments are subject to medical clearance. Issuance of a visa by the host country of the duty station is required for IP positions and will be facilitated by UNICEF. Appointments are conditional on the selected candidates willingness to comply with current or future vaccination requirements, should UNICEF mandate it for personnel. Failure to comply with such requirements, where applicable and without a duly approved medical exemption from the relevant UN authority, will result in the cancellation of the selection or may lead to other administrative measures, including separation from service. As per Article 101, paragraph 3, of the Charter of the United Nations, the paramount consideration in the employment of the staff is the necessity of securing the highest standards of efficiency, competence, and integrity. UNICEF is committed to fostering an inclusive, representative, and welcoming workforce. For this position, eligible and suitable Females are encouraged to apply. Government employees who are considered for employment with UNICEF are normally required to resign from their government positions before taking up an assignment with UNICEF. UNICEF reserves the right to withdraw an offer of appointment, without compensation, if a visa or medical clearance is not obtained, or necessary inoculation requirements are not met, within a reasonable period for any reason. UNICEF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). UNICEF will not ask for applicants' bank account information. Humanitarian action is a cross-cutting priority within UNICEF's Strategic Plan. UNICEF is committed to stay and deliver in humanitarian contexts. Therefore, all staff, at all levels across all functional areas, can be called upon to be deployed to support humanitarian response, contributing to both strengthening resilience of communities and capacity of national authorities. Visa residence requirements: i.e. UNICEF shall not facilitate the issuance of a visa and working authorization for candidates under consideration for positions at the national officer and general service category. All UNICEF positions are advertised, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and advance to the next stage of the selection process. An internal candidate performing at the level of the post in the relevant functional area, or an internal/external candidate in the corresponding Talent Group, may be selected, if suitable for the post, without assessment of other candidates. Additional information about working for UNICEF can be found here. Advertised: 07 Oct 2026 E. Africa Standard Time Deadline: 14 Oct 2026 E. Africa Standard Time

articles.final_html:
يعلن المركز الاستشفائي الجامعي محمد السادس بمراكش عن تنظيم مباراة لتوظيف ممرضين من الدرجة الأولى (السلم 10).

  • المؤهل المطلوب: 5يتضمن | مهندسدولةمسلممن 04 4| ساعات dd di 020 ne بالتخصصات | المعاهد أو َالجامعات000 3 9
  • الاختبار: 5يتضمن | مهندسدولةمسلممن 04 4| ساعات dd di 020 ne بالتخصصات | المعاهد أو َالجامعات000 3 9

تفاصيل المباراة

  • الإدارة المنظمة: المركز الاستشفائي الجامعي محمد السادس - مراكش
  • الدرجة: ممرض من الدرجة الأولى - سُلمْ 10
  • آخر أجل لإيداع الترشيحات: 22 أكتوبر 2026
  • تاريخ إجراء المباراة: 1 نونبر 2026
  • موقع إجراء المباراة: الكلية المتعددة التخصصات التابعة لجامعة القاضي عياض بمراكش، أو كلية العلوم القانونية والاقتصادية والاجتماعية، أو كلية الآداب والعلوم الإنسانية بمراكش.

شروط الترشيح

تفتح هذه المباراة في وجه المترشحين من الجنسية المغربية المتراوحة أعمارهم بين 18 و 45 سنة على الأكثر في فاتح يناير من السنة الجارية (40 سنة بالنسبة للممرضين).

يحتفظ بـ 25% من المناصب لفائدة قدماء المقاومين وأعضاء جيش التحرير وقدماء العسكريين ومكفولي الأمة، و 7% منها لفائدة الأشخاص في وضعية إعاقة. (هذه النسب تخص مجموع المناصب المعلن عنها في القرار الذي يشمل عدة درجات).

الدبلوم ونوع الاختبار

  • الدبلوم المطلوب: دبلوم الدولة للطور الثالث شبه الطبي، أو دبلوم العالي للمهن التمريضية وتقنيات الصحة، أو إحدى الشهادات أو الدبلومات المعادلة لها.
  • الاختبار: اختبار كتابي عام يتضمن أسئلة متعددة الاختيارات (QCM) حول تقنيات الصحة وتقييم مدى قدرة المرشح على القيام بالمهام المرتبطة بالتخصصات المطلوبة.

ملف الترشيح

يتعين على المترشحين التسجيل وإرفاق الوثائق التالية إلكترونيا عبر الموقع المخصص لذلك قبل الأجل المحدد:

  • طلب خطي يبين الاسم العائلي والشخصي للمترشح وعنوانه ورقم هاتفه والتخصص الذي تم اختياره.
  • نسخة مشهود بمطابقتها للأصل من الدبلوم المطلوب أو الشهادة المعادلة له، مصحوبة بنسخة من قرار المعادلة المنشور بالجريدة الرسمية (بالنسبة للحاصلين على الدبلومات والشهادات المعادلة).
  • سيرة ذاتية للمترشح تحمل صورته.
  • نسخة مشهود بمطابقتها للأصل لبطاقة التعريف الوطنية.
  • نسخة مشهود بمطابقتها للأصل تثبت صفة مقاوم أو مكفول الأمة أو عسكري قديم أو محارب قديم (بالنسبة للمتوفرين على هذه الصفة).
  • نسخة مشهود بمطابقتها للأصل لشهادة التسجيل في لوائح الأشخاص في وضعية إعاقة (بالنسبة للأشخاص في وضعية إعاقة).
  • ترخيص موقع من طرف الإدارة الأصلية لاجتياز المباراة (بالنسبة للمرشحين الموظفين).

لا يقبل أي ملف ترشيح يودع مباشرة بقسم الموارد البشرية أو عن طريق البريد، ولا يسمح بإيداع أكثر من ملف ترشيح واحد للمشاركة في المباراة.

طريقة الترشيح

يتم إيداع ملفات الترشيح وجوبا عبر البرمجية المعدة لهذا الغرض بالموقع الإلكتروني للمركز الاستشفائي الجامعي محمد السادس بمراكش:

منصة الترشيح الإلكترونية

وللاطلاع على تفاصيل الإعلان الرسمي للمباراة:

التقديم الرسمي

فتح رابط التقديم الرسمي

ملاحظات هامة

  • سيتم الإعلان عن لائحة المترشحين المقبولين لاجتياز المباراة على الموقع الإلكتروني للمركز الاستشفائي الجامعي محمد السادس بمراكش www.chumarrakech.ma وعلى بوابة الخدمات www.emploi-public.ma.
  • سيتم الإعلان عن النتائج النهائية بنفس الموقعين.
  • يلزم المترشحون الناجحون بصفة نهائية بتتميم ملفاتهم بالوثائق الإدارية المطلوبة نظاميا للتعيين بالوظيفة العمومية.

articles.seo_title: مباراة توظيف طبيبين من الدرجة الأولى بالمركز الاستشفائي الجامعي محمد السادس بمراكش
articles.seo_description: يعلن المركز الاستشفائي الجامعي محمد السادس بمراكش عن تنظيم مباراة لتوظيف طبيبين من الدرجة الأولى، مع تحديد شروط الترشيح وتواريخ الاختبارات.
articles.final_html:
يعلن المركز الاستشفائي الجامعي محمد السادس بمراكش عن تنظيم مباراة لتوظيف طبيبين (2) من الدرجة الأولى (السلم 11)، وذلك بهدف تعزيز أطره الطبية المتخصصة.

  • المؤهل المطلوب: 5يتضمن | مهندسدولةمسلممن 04 4| ساعات dd di 020 ne بالتخصصات | المعاهد أو َالجامعات000 3 9
  • الاختبار: 5يتضمن | مهندسدولةمسلممن 04 4| ساعات dd di 020 ne بالتخصصات | المعاهد أو َالجامعات000 3 9

المناصب المطلوبة

تفتح هذه المباراة في وجه حاملي دبلوم الدكتوراه في الطب العام أو الشهادات المعادلة له، لشغل منصبين (2) ضمن الدرجة المذكورة.

شروط الترشيح

  • أن يكون المترشح(ة) من جنسية مغربية.
  • ألا يتجاوز عمر المترشح(ة) 40 سنة في فاتح يناير من سنة إجراء المباراة (تطبق هذه الشروط على الأطباء).
  • أن يكون حاصلاً على دبلوم الدكتوراه في الطب العام أو شهادة معترف بمعادلتها له.

مراحل المباراة

تجرى الاختبارات الكتابية يوم 1 نونبر 2026، وتتضمن ما يلي:

  • اختبار كتابي عام: مدته ساعتان (المعامل 2)، يتضمن أسئلة مباشرة أو متعددة الاختيارات حول الطب الجماعي والصحة العامة.
  • اختبار كتابي خاص: مدته 3 ساعات (المعامل 3)، يتضمن أسئلة مرتبطة بالتخصصات المطلوبة بهدف تقييم مدى قدرة المرشح على القيام بالمهام أو الوظائف المرتبطة بالدرجة المتبارى بشأنها، في تخصصات مثل الفيزيولوجيا المرضية، البيولوجيا والصحة، علوم الأعصاب والبيوتكنولوجيا، والبيوتكنولوجيا الطبية.
  • اختبار شفوي: مدته تتراوح بين 15 و 30 دقيقة (المعامل 3)، يتعلق بالثقافة العامة وبالتخصص المتبارى بشأنه.

ملف الترشيح

يتعين على المترشحين إرفاق الوثائق التالية إلكترونيا عبر المنصة المخصصة لذلك:

  • طلب خطي يبين فيه الاسم العائلي والشخصي للمترشح، وعنوانه، ورقم هاتفه، والتخصص الذي تم اختياره.
  • نسخة مشهود بمطابقتها للأصل من الدبلوم المطلوب أو الشهادات المعادلة له. بالنسبة للحاصلين على شهادات معادلة، يجب إرفاق نسخة من قرار المعادلة المنشور بالجريدة الرسمية.
  • سيرة ذاتية للمترشح تحمل صورته (CV).
  • نسخة مشهود بمطابقتها للأصل من الوثائق التي تثبت صفة مقاوم، أو مكفول الأمة، أو عسكري قديم، أو محارب قديم (إن وجدت).
  • نسخة مشهود بمطابقتها للأصل من شهادة التسجيل في لوائح الأشخاص في وضعية إعاقة (للأشخاص المعنيين).
  • ترخيص موقع من الإدارة الأصلية لاجتياز المباراة (بالنسبة للمرشحين الموظفين).

كيفية الترشيح

تودع ملفات الترشيح وجوبا عبر البرمجية المخصصة لذلك على الموقع الإلكتروني للمركز الاستشفائي الجامعي محمد السادس بمراكش، وذلك قبل الساعة 16:00 من يوم 22 أكتوبر 2026. لن تُقبل أي ملفات ترشيح تودع مباشرة بقسم الموارد البشرية أو عن طريق البريد العادي، كما يعتبر كل ملف ترشيح تنقصه إحدى الوثائق المذكورة أعلاه ملغى.

روابط ومعلومات هامة

  • صفحة الإعلان الرسمي للمباراة على بوابة التشغيل العمومي: https://www.emploi-public.ma/ar/%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%B5%D9%8A%D9%84/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA/
  • قرار فتح المباراة (وثيقة رسمية): https://www.emploi-public.ma/ar/%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%84/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA/arrete/

يعلن المركز الاستشفائي الجامعي محمد السادس بمراكش عن تنظيم مباراة لتوظيف طبيبين (2) من الدرجة الأولى (السلم 11).

🎓 تفتح هذه المباراة في وجه حاملي دبلوم الدكتوراه في الطب العام أو الشهادات المعادلة له، بشرط ألا يتجاوز العمر 40 سنة في فاتح يناير من سنة إجراء المباراة.

⏳ آخر موعد لتقديم الترشيحات هو 22 أكتوبر 2026 قبل الساعة 16:00، وستجرى الاختبارات الكتابية يوم 1 نونبر 2026.

للاطلاع على تفاصيل المباراة، شروط الترشيح، وكيفية التقديم، يرجى زيارة الرابط في أول تعليق. 👇

articles.job_description: Apply now Job no: 596145 Contract type: Consultant Duty Station: Conakry Level: Consultancy Location: Guinea Categories: Research, Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. The consultant will make the following editions: 1.Check for and correct redundancies, spelling, or grammar mistakes, improve the language. 2. Proofread the overall report to ensure that the content is relevant and clearly understandable to external audience and adjust where necessary. 3. Check for coherence amongst Programme components throughout the document, including statistical data used. 4. Ensure full compliance with the 2026 COAR Instructions. 5. Editing and proofreading all content to ensure clarity, coherence, and consistency with UNICEF’s style guidelines. If you would like to know more about this consultancy, please review the complete Terms of Reference here: TMC0006732 external TOR.pdf To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have... QUALIFICATIONS / SPECIALIZED KNOWLEDGE / EXPERIENCE/ COMPETENCIES (CORE/TECHNICAL/FUNCTIONAL) / LANGUAGE SKILLS REQUIRED FOR THE ASSIGNMENT Minimum Qualifications required:Masters .Master degree ( BAC+5) in Communication, Social Sciences, development studies, or other relevant fields. Years of Experience/ Knowledge/Expertise/Skills required: ▪ At least 5 years of proven relevant experience in the field of professional English and French writing, editing of national and international development reports. ▪ Previous annual reports writing experience, particularly UNICEF reports, will be considered as an asset. ▪ Sound knowledge and skills on results-based reporting, monitoring and evaluation. ▪ Demonstrated experience in working with UNICEF would be an asset. ▪ Capacity to work under pressure and deliver quality inputs to meet deadlines. Language Requirements:French and English. Excellent report writing, editing, and proofreading skills. Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise, and compelling narratives. Demonstrated experience in results-based reporting, monitoring and evaluation, and performance reporting. Ability to review and validate quantitative and qualitative data for accuracy, consistency, and coherence. Strong understanding of Results-Based Management (RBM) principles and UNICEF programming frameworks. Proven ability to transform technical programme content into audience-friendly communication products. Excellent attention to detail and quality assurance skills. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including document formatting, editing, track changes, and document quality control. Strong commitment to accuracy, confidentiality, and professional ethics. Strong understanding of UNICEF programming, child rights, and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Familiarity with UNICEF Country Office Annual Reporting (COAR) processes and reporting requirements is highly desirable. • A technical proposal including their understanding of the assignment, proposed methodology, training approach and sample workplan; UNICEF’s Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status. UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance. UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. UNICEF is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks, and will be expected to adhere to these standards and principles. Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check, and selected candidates with disabilities may be requested to submit supporting documentation in relation to their disability confidentially. Qualified candidates are invited to submit the following documents via the online recruitment portal, TMS (Talent Management System): An up-to-date TMS profile and curriculum vitae (CV) A separate financial proposal (only acceptable in the format of the linked template) TMC0006732 FINANCIAL PROPOSAL.docx A detailed technical proposal including their understanding of the assignment, proposed methodology, training approach and sample workplan. Remarks: If the TOR or financial proposal documents are not downloadable on certain recruitment platforms, please visit our official page Vacancies | UNICEF Careers . UNICEF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). UNICEF will not ask for applicants’ bank account information. All UNICEF positions are advertised, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and advance to the next stage of the selection process. Additional information about working for UNICEF can be found here. Advertised: 07 Oct 2026 Greenwich Standard Time Deadline: 18 Oct 2026 Greenwich Standard Time

UNICEF Ukraine is seeking a national Communication Consultant to develop and deliver communication products, campaign materials, reports and activation packages that raise awareness of the situation of children and young people, highlight the impact of the war and support engagement and advocacy for children's rights. Under the supervision of the Chief of Communication & Advocacy, the consultant will: Produce high-quality content to be published on UNICEF Ukraine channels and disseminated widely. Produce and manage a media directory with information on type of engagement, mention or interview log. If you would like to know more about this consultancy, please review the complete Terms of Reference attached to this vacancy notice Communication_Consultant_Ukraine_External_TOR.pdf . To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have… Education: Master's degree in Communication, Journalism, Advertising, Marketing, International Relations or Humanities. Work Experience: Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible professional experience in communication, media, journalism, marketing, or a related field, including hands-on experience managing multimedia campaigns, public-facing activations, and content production. Experience working in a humanitarian, development, or UN/NGO context is required, ideally within an emergency response setting. Demonstrated experience planning and delivering communication campaigns and activations for diverse public audiences, from concept through post-activation reporting. Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with experience coordinating across government counterparts, media, partner organizations, and field offices to deliver time-bound outputs. Proven track record producing high-quality content (video, photo, written) for digital and traditional media channels. Experience organizing and supporting high-level or donor visits, including logistics, briefing materials, and media coordination. Sound understanding of media relations, including managing press engagement logs and journalist/media contacts. Ability to work independently under tight deadlines and manage multiple concurrent deliverables. Sensitivity to child rights, child safeguarding, and ethical content standards in a conflict-affected context. Excellent written and spoken English and Ukrainian. Prior experience with UNICEF or another UN agency, particularly in a Communication & Advocacy function. Experience producing or commissioning long-form/documentary content. Existing network of media contacts within Ukraine. Experience in crisis or emergency communications. articles.job_description: تخصص : - العلوم الزراعية تخصص: الإنتاج النباتي أو ما يعادله الدرجة : مهندس دولة من الدرجة الأولى - سُلمْ 11 نوع الإيداع : الإيداع عبر الإنترنت على موقع emploi-public معلومات إضافية : 1) شروط الترشيح: تفتح المباراة في وجه المترشحين من جنسية مغربية، شرط أن لا يتجاوزوا سن الإحالة على التقاعد طبقا للنصوص التشريعية الجاري بها العمل، والحاصلين على دبلوم مهندس دولة أو ما يعادله في التخصصين المشار إليهما أعلاه. 2) نوعية الاختبارات: تشتمل المباراة على اختبار كتابي واختبار شفوي. 3) مسطرة الترشيح: يجب تسجيل طلب الترشيح وجوبا على موقع التشغيل العمومي https://depot.emploi-public.ma وذلك ابتداء من 07 أكتوبر الى غاية 22 أكتوبر 2026 على الساعة الثالثة والنصف بعد الزوال (H3015(. يرفق هذا الطلب بالوثائق التالية:  طلب خطي؛  نسخة من البطاقة الوطنية للتعريف؛  نسخة من السيرة الذاتية للمترشح (Curriculum vitae)؛  نسخة من الشهادة المطلوبة، مصحوبة بقرار المعادلة بالنسبة للشهادات الأجنبية أو الشهادات المسلمة من طرف مؤسسات التعليم العالي الخاص المعتمدة من طرف السلطة الحكومية المكلفة بالتعليم العالي. 4) ملاحظات هامة:  تنشر لوائح المترشحين المقبولين والتي تعتبر بمثابة استدعاء لاجتياز الاختبار الكتابي، على الموقع الالكتروني www.emploi-public.ma؛ وعلى الموقع الالكتروني للمدرسة الوطنية للفلاحة www.enameknes.ac.ma؛ وتصبح هذه اللوائح نهائية يومين بعد نشرها؛  يعتبر لاغيا كل ملف ترشيح يصل بعد التاريخ المحدد لإيداع الملفات؛  يعتبر لاغيا كل ملف ترشيح تنقصه احدى الوثائق المطلوبة. هذا الفضاء مخصص لطرح الأسئلة والاستفسارات فقط، وليس لإيداع ملفات الترشيح. تم إرسال رسالة لتأكيد تسجيل حسابك. يرجى التحقق من رسائل البريد الإلكتروني الخاصة بك

articles.job_description: تخصص : - العلوم الزراعية تخصص: هندسة التنمية القروية أو ما يعادلها الدرجة : مهندس دولة من الدرجة الأولى - سُلمْ 11 نوع الإيداع : الإيداع عبر الإنترنت على موقع emploi-public معلومات إضافية : 1) شروط الترشيح: تفتح المباراة في وجه المترشحين من جنسية مغربية، شرط أن لا يتجاوزوا سن الإحالة على التقاعد طبقا للنصوص التشريعية الجاري بها العمل، والحاصلين على دبلوم مهندس دولة أو ما يعادله في التخصصين المشار إليهما أعلاه. 2) نوعية الاختبارات: تشتمل المباراة على اختبار كتابي واختبار شفوي. 3) مسطرة الترشيح: يجب تسجيل طلب الترشيح وجوبا على موقع التشغيل العمومي https://depot.emploi-public.ma وذلك ابتداء من 07 أكتوبر الى غاية 22 أكتوبر 2026 على الساعة الثالثة والنصف بعد الزوال (H3015(. يرفق هذا الطلب بالوثائق التالية:  طلب خطي؛  نسخة من البطاقة الوطنية للتعريف؛  نسخة من السيرة الذاتية للمترشح (Curriculum vitae)؛  نسخة من الشهادة المطلوبة، مصحوبة بقرار المعادلة بالنسبة للشهادات الأجنبية أو الشهادات المسلمة من طرف مؤسسات التعليم العالي الخاص المعتمدة من طرف السلطة الحكومية المكلفة بالتعليم العالي. 4) ملاحظات هامة:  تنشر لوائح المترشحين المقبولين والتي تعتبر بمثابة استدعاء لاجتياز الاختبار الكتابي، على الموقع الالكتروني www.emploi-public.ma؛ وعلى الموقع الالكتروني للمدرسة الوطنية للفلاحة www.enameknes.ac.ma؛ وتصبح هذه اللوائح نهائية يومين بعد نشرها؛  يعتبر لاغيا كل ملف ترشيح يصل بعد التاريخ المحدد لإيداع الملفات؛  يعتبر لاغيا كل ملف ترشيح تنقصه احدى الوثائق المطلوبة. هذا الفضاء مخصص لطرح الأسئلة والاستفسارات فقط، وليس لإيداع ملفات الترشيح. تم إرسال رسالة لتأكيد تسجيل حسابك. يرجى التحقق من رسائل البريد الإلكتروني الخاصة بك

articles.job_description: Apply now Job no: 596149 Contract type: Consultant Duty Station: Kabul Level: Consultancy Location: Afghanistan Categories: Nutrition UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture., coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. https://youtu.be/PKSi-6RAhxc?si=IFjgmiX42Ldj7hF7 Afghanistan country office is seeking an experienced home-based Consultant to prepare and deliver a high-quality strategic engagement to a high-level audience of donors, diplomats and development partners that: Takes stock of progress against the commitments of the London Compact. Outlines key recommendations and asks from the ACG to accelerate the London Compact commitments. Initial review of available documentation and briefing with UNICEF leadership; carry out a rapid stock-take of progress against the London Compact milestones with all relevant partners Stock-take report on progress against London Compact milestones, with key recommendations for future Attendance at the ACG meeting for delivery of the nutrition session. Delivery of presentation and final meeting notes. To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have… Education: Advanced university degree (Master's level or higher) in Nutrition, Public Health, Epidemiology, Medicine, International Development, Health Economics or related field. Work Experience: Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible experience in nutrition, public health, humanitarian response and/or health systems. Skill: Recognized experience and leadership of international nutrition programming and translating complex technical information into strategic messages for senior decision-makers. Proven experience presenting to donor, diplomatic, governmental or executive audiences. Strong understanding of nutrition programming in fragile, conflict-affected and humanitarian settings. Experience in Afghanistan and/or South Asia region is highly desirable. Familiarity with financing, health systems and development policy discussions is an asset. UNICEF’s Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values The UNICEF competencies required for this post are… (2) Demonstrates self-awareness and ethical awareness Familiarize yourself with our competency framework and its different levels. UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status. UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer a wide range of benefits to our staff, including paid parental leave, breastfeeding breaks and reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. UNICEF provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance. UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, fraud, corruption and other forms of misconduct. UNICEF is committed to promoting the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference, safeguarding and background verification checks. These checks may include verification of academic credentials and employment history, screening against relevant United Nations misconduct databases, and requests for misconduct disclosures from current and former employers, professional associations, other relevant organizations and participating organizations under inter-agency safeguarding initiatives, including the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS), where applicable. Appointment, selection and continued engagement are subject to the satisfactory completion of all required checks. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information and consent to enable UNICEF to undertake these checks. Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check, and selected candidates with disabilities may be requested to submit supporting documentation in relation to their disability confidentially UNICEF appointments are subject to medical clearance. Issuance of a visa by the host country of the duty station is required for IP positions and will be facilitated by UNICEF. Appointments are conditional on the selected candidates’ willingness to comply with current or future vaccination requirements, should UNICEF mandate it for personnel. Failure to comply with such requirements, where applicable and without a duly approved medical exemption from the relevant UN authority, will result in the cancellation of the selection or may lead to other administrative measures, including separation from service As per Article 101, paragraph 3, of the Charter of the United Nations, the paramount consideration in the employment of the staff is the necessity of securing the highest standards of efficiency, competence, and integrity. UNICEF is committed to fostering an inclusive, representative, and welcoming workforce. For this position, eligible and suitable candidates are encouraged to apply. Government employees who are considered for employment with UNICEF are normally required to resign from their government positions before taking up an assignment with UNICEF. UNICEF reserves the right to withdraw an offer of appointment, without compensation, if a visa or medical clearance is not obtained, or necessary inoculation requirements are not met, within a reasonable period for any reason. UNICEF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). UNICEF will not ask for applicants’ bank account information. Humanitarian action is a cross-cutting priority within UNICEF’s Strategic Plan. UNICEF is committed to stay and deliver in humanitarian contexts. Therefore, all staff, at all levels across all functional areas, can be called upon to be deployed to support humanitarian response, contributing to both strengthening resilience of communities and capacity of national authorities. All UNICEF positions are advertised, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and advance to the next stage of the selection process. An internal candidate performing at the level of the post in the relevant functional area, or an internal/external candidate in the corresponding Talent Group, may be selected, if suitable for the post, without assessment of other candidates. Additional information about working for UNICEF can be found here. Advertised: 07 Oct 2026 Afghanistan Standard Time Deadline: 11 Oct 2026 Afghanistan Standard Time

« Maitrise رد ayant le profil indiqué dans le tableau ci-dessous : 0
l’annonce pourvoir
| tr | | Spécialitéétablissement: GéniepublicCivilououprivééquivalent.reconnu par l'Etat (Bac+2). Expérience : Souhaitable.
Age : Maximum 40 ans au 31/12/2026;
1. Dossier de candidature :
- Les pièces composant le dossier de candidature scanné sont les suivantes :
% Une copie de la CNIE originale (Recto-verso) ;
% Un curriculum vitae (CV) détaillé et actualisé ;
% Les attestations de travail justifiant l'expérience et comportant obligatoirement l'emploi occupé et la période de travail (à insérer au niveau de
(«%la rubrique «||التجريةالمهنيةالمطلوية المرشحعلى تثبتتوفر التي دهاوشلا : المع copie du baccalauréat original (à insérer au niveau de la rubrique » ةيملعلا قالهؤم ;)»
% Une copie du diplôme original (à insérer au niveau de la rubrique « العلمية مؤهلاق )»Les; diplômes doivent être délivrés par des établissements
nationaux mandatés conformément à la réglementation en vigueur. Une équivalence du diplôme est exigée au cas où le diplôme est délivré
par un établissement étranger accompagné de tous les documents réglementaires prouvant ladite équivalence (Décision d'équivalence,
bulletin officiel, … : (à insérer au niveau de la rubrique « المعادلة قرار ;)»
% Le dossier de candidature doit parvenir avant le ? CCI 20 à 23h 59min ;
% Toutes les candidatures doivent exclusivement être déposées via le lien : https://www.emploi-public.ma . A ce titre, toutes les candidatures
incomplètes ou déposées autrement que via le site emploi-public, ne seront pas prises en compte et ne feront pas l’objet de suite de la part
de ملقم.
Il. Organisation du Concours :
% Le concours se déroulera en deux (02) épreuves (épreuve écrite et épreuve orale). Seuls les candidats ayant réussi l'épreuve écrite sont éligibles
à passer l'épreuve % orale; Les candidats retenus sur la base de la note moyenne des deux épreuves (écrite et orale), seront classés par ordre de mérite et dans la limite
du nombre de postes à % pourvoir; La date et lieu du concours, la liste des candidats présélectionnés, la liste des candidats admis et la liste d'attente seront publiés sur les sites
web : https://www.emploi-public.ma et www.anp.org.ma ;
% Les candidats admis seront également informés par e-mail.
NB:
- Les fichiers doivent être de type : PDF, JPG, PNG ;
- La taille de chaque fichier ne doit pas dépasser 1 (Mo) ;
- Le recrutement n’est définitif qu'après la production de tous les documents constitutifs du dossier administratif ;
- Pour toute information complémentaire, les candidats peuvent contacter la Direction Capital Humain à l'adresse suivante :
candidatures@anp.org.ma .

  • الدرجة: متصرف من الدرجة الثانية - سلم 11
  • عدد المناصب: 2
  • التخصصات:
    • التدبير المالي أو المحاسبة
    • التدقيق ومراقبة التسيير

شروط الترشيح

يجب على المترشحين استيفاء الشروط التالية:

  • أن يكون المترشح من جنسية مغربية.
  • أن يتراوح سن المترشح ما بين 18 و 45 سنة على الأكثر بالنسبة لغير الموظفين.
  • أن يكون حاصلاً على دبلوم الماستر أو دبلوم الدراسات العليا المتخصصة أو دبلوم الدراسات العليا المعمقة، أو إحدى الشهادات المعادلة لها وفقاً للمقتضيات النظامية الجاري بها العمل، وذلك في أحد التخصصات المطلوبة.
  • تخصص نسبة 25% من المناصب للمكفولين والأشخاص المتوفرين على صفة قدماء المقاومين أو قدماء العسكريين.
  • تخصص نسبة 7% للأشخاص في وضعية إعاقة الحاملين لبطاقة "شخص معاق".

الاختبارات

تشتمل المباراة على اختبارات كتابية وشفوية أو تطبيقية. يتأهل لاجتياز الاختبار الشفوي المترشحون الحاصلون على معدل لا يقل عن 12/20 في الاختبار الكتابي ودون الحصول على نقطة إقصائية.

تستغرق الاختبارات الشفوية أو التطبيقية مدة تتراوح بين 15 و 30 دقيقة. تناقش خلالها لجنة المباراة مع المرشح مواضيع وقضايا مختلفة وذات الصلة باختصاصات المدرسة أو التخصصات المطلوبة، أو يخضع لاختبار تطبيقي يدخل ضمن مهام هيئة المتصرفين، وذلك بهدف تقييم مدى قدرته على ممارسة المهام والوظائف المرتبطة بالدرجة المتبارى بشأنها.

ملف الترشيح

يتكون ملف الترشيح من الوثائق التالية:

  • طلب خطي يحمل عنوان المترشح، رقم هاتفه، وبريده الإلكتروني، موجه إلى مدير المدرسة الوطنية العليا للمعادن بالرباط.
  • سيرة ذاتية محينة تحمل صورة وعنوان المترشح.
  • نسخة مصادق عليها من الدبلوم أو إحدى الشهادات المعادلة له، مصحوبة بنسخة من قرار المعادلة عند الاقتضاء.
  • نسخة مصادق عليها من البطاقة الوطنية للتعريف الإلكترونية.
  • ترخيص نهائي لاجتياز المباراة مسلم من طرف المصالح المكلفة بتدبير الموارد البشرية، وذلك بالنسبة للمرشحين الموظفين.

كيفية الترشيح والآجال

تودع ملفات الترشيح وجوباً على البرمجية الإلكترونية عبر المنصة المخصصة للإدارة.

  • آخر أجل لإيداع الترشيحات: 21 أكتوبر 2026 على الساعة 16:30 زوالاً.
  • تاريخ إجراء المباراة: 1 نونبر 2026.

سيتم نشر لائحة المرشحين المقبولين لاجتياز الاختبار الكتابي للمباراة على البوابة الإلكترونية للتشغيل العمومي وموقع المدرسة الوطنية العليا للمعادن بالرباط، ويعتبر هذا بمثابة استدعاء للمرشحين.

nationaux mandatés conformément à la réglementation en vigueur :

doivent obligatoirement être visés par le président de l'université publique dont relèvent ces universités et établissements et ce,
conformément au décret n° 2.14.665 (article 7).

à passer l'épreuve orale;
% دعا candidats retenus sur la base de la note moyenne des deux épreuves (écrite et orale), seront classés par ordre de mérite et dans la limite
du nombre de postes à pourvoir ;

articles.seo_description: مباراة توظيف تقني من الدرجة الثالثة – سُلم 9 في المدرسة الوطنية العليا للمعادن بالرباط. 6 وظائف، آخر أجل 21 أكتوبر 2026، اختبار 1 نونبر 2026.
articles.final_html:
تعلن المدرسة الوطنية العليا للمعادن بالرباط عن مباراة توظيف تقني من الدرجة الثالثة – سُلم 9، لفتح ستة وظائف. آخر أجل لتقديم الترشيحات هو 21 أكتوبر 2026، مع اختبار في 1 نونبر 2026.

عدد المناصب: 6 منصب

المتطلبات الأساسية

  • جنسية مغربية.
  • سن بين 18 و40 سنة.
  • حاصل على دبلوم تقني في أحد التخصصات التالية:
  • الشبكات المعلوماتية/التطوير المعلوماتي
  • كتابة الإدارة
  • الهندسة الكهربائية
  • هندسة العمليات الصناعية
  • السمعي البصري أو تقنيات الصوت والصورة

الاختبارات

  • اختبار كتابي (الحد الأدنى 20/12).
  • اختبار شفوي.

المستندات المطلوبة

  • سيرة ذاتية.
  • صورة شخصية.
  • نسخة من الدبلوم.
  • بطاقة هوية وطنية.

طريقة التقديم

يُطلب الإيداع الإلكتروني عبر فتح منصة الترشيح الرسمية. يُرجى التأكد من إتمام التسجيل وإرسال رسالة التأكيد.

معلومات إضافية

  • تاريخ إجراء المباراة: 1 نونبر 2026.
  • آخر أجل لتقديم الترشيحات: 21 أكتوبر 2026، الساعة 16:30.

للمزيد من التفاصيل، يمكن الاطلاع على تفاصيل المباراة أو تحميل الوثائق التالية:

  • قرار فتح المباراة
  • الإعلان

articles.job_description: Apply now Job no: 596147 Contract type: Consultant Duty Station: Suva Level: Consultancy Location: Fiji/Pacific Island Countries Categories: Education ************************************************************************************ ************************************************************************************ UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. For every child, the right to Education. UNICEF Pacific is seeking technical assistance to strengthen the use of education data for evidence-informed sector planning, policy dialogue and programme design across selected Pacific Island countries. Over the coming 12 months, several countries supported by the UNICEF Pacific Multi-Country Office will be undertaking, finalizing or disseminating MICS surveys, results and analytical products related to Education and ECD, including contextualization of MICS training notes on Education and ECD, contextualization of FLS modules, support to MICS-EAGLE and other targeted products for Education and ECD, cross-sectoral analysis related to resilience and education, and MICS-EMIS (MICS-Link) analyses.. This creates an important opportunity to support Ministries of Education and related Ministries, as relevant, to engage with MICS processes from the outset, contextualize tools appropriately, and use resulting data alongside EMIS and other administrative datasets for decision-making. This further creates an opportunity to coordinate more closely with regional organizations with leading roles in data to demonstrate the complementarity of MICS and other data. In addition, UNICEF Pacific will be engaging in the development of the next 5-year MCPD, requiring thoughtful analysis of key issues for children across the 14 Pacific Island countries and territories served by the Pacific office. The technical support provided will ensure MICS and relevant education-related data is used to the maximum possible extent in guiding the direction of the MCPD 2028-2032. The consultancy will contribute to UNICEF Pacific’s broader education data and evidence agenda, including early childhood development, school readiness, inclusive education, climate resilience and other emerging priorities. The overall purpose is to help ensure that education data investments translate into practical, country-owned recommendations, stronger monitoring systems, and more equitable and responsive education programming across the Pacific. The consultant will provide technical support to UNICEF Pacific and select Ministries of Education to strengthen the earliest possible engagement with the preparation, analysis, interpretation, dissemination and use of MICS, EMIS and other education datasets. The work will be organized around five main workstreams, with specific country support to be prioritized jointly with UNICEF Pacific during the assignment period. A cross all areas of work, the consultant will apply equity, gender and inclusion lens, including through disaggregated analysis where data allow. The assignment will provide targeted technical support to UNICEF Pacific and government partners in several Pacific countries (including, Samoa, RMI, Solomon Islands, Kiribati, Fiji and other prioritized countries), depending on evolving needs and timelines. The consultant will support the analysis, interpretation, dissemination and uptake of MICS and EMIS data, with a particular focus on strengthening linkages between household survey data and education administrative data for sector review, planning and advocacy. The assignment will also support foundational learning data work, including FLS adaptation and analysis, and help position MICS learning data in relation to PILNA, EGRA/EGMA, national assessments and examinations. 1. MICS-EMIS linkages and use for sector planning The consultant will support UNICEF Pacific and selected Pacific Ministries of Education to strengthen the engagement in MICS processes and use of MICS data alongside EMIS and other administrative education datasets for sector review, planning and decision-making. This may include support to ongoing or planned MICS-EMIS work in selected Pacific countries, such as Samoa, RMI and Solomon Islands, depending on government interest and data availability. The consultant will also support technical discussions or workshops with Ministries of Education, UNICEF colleagues (HQ/Pacific) and other partners; prepare/consolidate the identification of priority policy questions; coordinate with the MICS team to analyze relevant indicators; and help prepare short reports, policy briefs, slide decks or advocacy products as useful and relevant to each context for Ministries of Education to translate findings into practical recommendations for education planning. 2. Foundational learning data, FLS adaptation and learning outcomes strategy The consultant will support UNICEF Pacific’s work on foundational learning and learning outcomes data, including MICS Foundational Learning Skills, PILNA, EGRA/EGMA, national assessments and examinations. This may include early engagement with government and MICS teams; World Bank and SPC’s EQAP on FLS contextualization in selected Pacific countries, such as Kiribati and Fiji; review of adapted tools and technical materials; and support to the analysis and interpretation of MICS learning data where available. The consultant will also prepare a short regional note on the learning outcomes data landscape in the Pacific, identifying key data sources, gaps, opportunities for better alignment, and potential areas where UNICEF Pacific can add value in the next MCPD period. 3. ECD data, school readiness and early learning The consultant will support UNICEF Pacific to better understand and use MICS data related to early childhood development, school readiness and early learning. This may include reviewing relevant MICS ECD indicators, identifying key messages for education and ECD programming, and exploring how MICS data can complement other ECD measurement efforts, including EHCI and country-level monitoring systems. The work should help UNICEF Pacific identify practical entry points for using ECD data in policy dialogue, programme design, advocacy and cross-sectoral collaboration. 4. Climate, resilience and education data scoping The consultant will support initial scoping on how education data systems in the Pacific can better capture issues related to climate risk, resilience and education continuity. This may include reviewing existing indicators and data sources, identifying gaps in current education data systems, and proposing potential areas for future programming particularly in Fiji; FSM; Kiribati and Solomon Islands. The consultant may also support UNICEF Pacific to identify how MICS, EMIS, school-level data and other datasets could better inform planning for climate-resilient education systems, especially in small island, remote and climate-vulnerable contexts where smaller scale but frequent emergencies are resulting in learning losses. 5. Education data and evidence support for capacity development The consultant will provide technical support to UNICEF Pacific on emerging education data and evidence priorities during the consultancy period. This will include data analysis for MCPD development, donor reporting, regional meetings, programme briefs, products, internal strategy processes, or country-level technical support where there is a clear strategic need. This flexible component is intended to ensure that the consultancy can respond to evolving country timelines, (MICS) data availability, Ministry requests and UNICEF Pacific capacity needs and programme priorities. If you would like to know more about this consultancy, please review the complete Terms of Reference here: Terms Of Reference TMC0006509.pdf To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have... Education, statistics, economics, public policy, social sciences, international development, data science, demography, or another relevant field. A minimum of five years of relevant professional experience in education data, quantitative analysis, monitoring and evaluation, learning assessment, EMIS, household survey data, or education sector planning. Demonstrated experience supporting the analysis and use of education data for policy dialogue, sector review, planning, advocacy or programme design is required. Fluency in English is required, including strong written communication skills and the ability to prepare clear, concise and policy-relevant analytical products. Strong quantitative analytical skills, including experience working with large education datasets and using statistical software such as Stata, R, SPSS, Python or equivalent. Good understanding of MICS, EMIS, education indicators, foundational learning data, learning assessments and/or early childhood development data. Ability to translate complex data into practical recommendations for government counterparts, UNICEF teams and partners. Knowledge of key thematic areas relevant to education data use in the Pacific, including foundational learning, learning outcomes, ECD and early learning, climate-resilient education, gender, equity and inclusive education. Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing timelines and produce high-quality outputs in a remote or multi-country working environment. Experience with MICS, MICS-EMIS/MICS Link, MICS-EAGLE, MICS Foundational Learning Skills, PILNA, EGRA/EGMA, national assessments or examinations is highly desirable. Prior experience working in the Pacific, small island developing states or complex multi-country contexts is an asset. Experience working with UNICEF, Ministries of Education, or development partners in low- and middle-income countries is an asset. Knowledge of a Pacific language is an asset. UNICEF’s Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values This position has been assessed as an elevated risk role for Child Safeguarding purposes as it is either a role with direct contact with children, a role that works directly with identifiable children’s data, a safeguarding response role, or an assessed risk role. Additional vetting and assessment for elevated risk roles in child safeguarding (potentially including additional criminal background checks) apply. UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status. UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance. UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. UNICEF is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks, and will be expected to adhere to these standards and principles. Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check, and selected candidates with disabilities may be requested to submit supporting documentation in relation to their disability confidentially. Qualified candidates are invited to submit the following documents via the online recruitment portal, TMS (Talent Management System): An up-to-date TMS profile and curriculum vitae (CV) A separate financial proposal (only acceptable in the format of the linked template) Financial proposal TMC0006509.docx Remarks: If the TOR or financial proposal documents are not downloadable on certain recruitment platforms, please visit our official page Vacancies | UNICEF Careers . UNICEF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). UNICEF will not ask for applicants’ bank account information. All UNICEF positions are advertised, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and advance to the next stage of the selection process. Additional information about working for UNICEF can be found here. Advertised: 07 Oct 2026 Fiji Standard Time Deadline: 20 Oct 2026 Fiji Standard Time

articles.job_description: Description de l'entreprise Chez Devoteam, nous sommes des « Digital Transformakers ». Le respect, la franchise et la passion animent chaque jour notre tribu. Ensemble, nous aidons nos clients à remporter la bataille du Digital : du conseil à la mise en œuvre de technologies innovantes, jusqu’à l’adoption des usages. Cloud, Cybersecurity, Data, DevOps, Fullstack Dev, Low Code, RPA n’ont plus aucun secret pour notre tribu ! articles.job_description: Apply now Job no: 596152 Contract type: Consultant Duty Station: La Paz Level: Consultancy Location: Bolivia Categories: Health and Nutrition A fin de fortalecer la rectoría del Ministerio de Salud y Deportes en la formulación de políticas públicas orientadas a promover una alimentación saludable, sostenible, culturalmente pertinentes y adaptadas al contexto nacional, la consultoría “Elaboración del Documento Base: Lineamientos técnicos científicos para las Guías Alimentarias basadas en Sistemas Alimentarios Sostenibles (GABSA)” busca generar las bases conceptuales, técnicas y científicas, que permita al Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia iniciar el proceso de desarrollo de Guías Alimentarias basados en Sistemas Alimentarios Sostenibles para el curso de vida, mediante la consolidación de la evidencia disponible nacional e internacional, la identificación de brechas de información y la definición de principios orientadores adaptados al contexto nacional. Bolivia atraviesa una compleja situación epidemiológica y alimentaria caracterizada por la coexistencia de múltiples formas de malnutrición, expresadas en anemia, desnutrición crónica, sobrepeso, obesidad y enfermedades no transmisibles relacionadas con la alimentación. Esta situación afecta de manera diferenciada a los distintos grupos poblacionales del curso de vida y refleja profundas transformaciones en los patrones de consumo alimentario, los entornos alimentarios y los sistemas de producción y abastecimiento de alimentos. El actual perfil epidemiológico nutricional evidencia la persistencia de deficiencias nutricionales en grupos vulnerables, particularmente durante la ventana crítica de los primeros mil días, coexistiendo con un incremento sostenido del consumo de alimentos ultraprocesados de alta densidad calórica y bajo valor nutricional. Esta transición alimentaria se encuentra estrechamente vinculada con cambios estructurales en los sistemas alimentarios, incluyendo la urbanización acelerada, el sedentarismo, modificaciones en los hábitos de consumo, pérdida de la biodiversidad alimentaria y creciente dependencia de productos industrializados. En concordancia con las recomendaciones de la Organización de las Naciones Unidas para la Alimentación y la Agricultura (FAO), la Organización Mundial de la Salud (OMS), UNICEF y otros organismos internacionales, los países de la región están transitando hacia la construcción de Guías Alimentarias Basadas en Sistemas Alimentarios Sostenibles, incorporando enfoques integrales que articulan salud, nutrición, cultura alimentaria, sostenibilidad ambiental, producción local, biodiversidad y soberanía alimentaria. Estos avances han permitido identificar vacíos de información relacionados con los patrones de consumo alimentario, los entornos alimentarios, la disponibilidad y acceso a alimentos saludables, la sostenibilidad de los sistemas alimentarios y los mecanismos de monitoreo y evaluación de futuras guías alimentarias. En consecuencia, la presente consultoría debe recuperar, actualizar y profundizar dichos avances, integrándolos en un marco técnico-científico nacional para la construcción de las futuras Guías Alimentarias Basadas en Sistemas Alimentarios Sostenibles para el curso de vida. La consultoría deberá considerar como insumos técnicos de referencia, entre otros: Perfil Epidemiológico Nutricional de Bolivia elaborado por la Unidad de Alimentación y Nutrición. Documento técnico preliminar de Proceso Nacional para las Guías Alimentarias Basadas en Sistemas Alimentarios Sostenibles (GABSA) desarrollado por la Unidad de Alimentación y Nutrición. Guías Alimentarias Basadas en Alimentos vigentes en Bolivia. Ley Nº 775 de Promoción de Alimentación Saludable. Normativa nacional relacionada con alimentación, nutrición, inocuidad alimentaria, seguridad alimentaria y nutricional y protección de la lactancia materna. Documentos metodológicos de FAO para el desarrollo de Guías Alimentarias Basadas en Sistemas Alimentarios Sostenibles. Recomendaciones técnicas de alimentación saludable de la OMS/OPS, UNICEF, FAO, BID, PMA y otros organismos internacionales pertinentes. Recomendaciones técnicas de alimentación saludable de la OMS/OPS, UNICEF, FAO, BID, PMA y otros organismos internacionales pertinentes. Guías Alimentarias Basadas en Sistemas Alimentarios Sostenibles desarrolladas por países de América Latina y el Caribe. El objetivo de la consultoría es la elaboración del documento técnico base denominado “Lineamientos técnicos científicos para las guías alimentarias basadas en sistemas alimentarios sostenibles”, incorporando evidencia científica, análisis de la situación alimentaria y nutricional, enfoque de sistemas alimentarios sostenibles, como insumo para las siguientes fases del proceso nacional de construcción de las GABSA. Analizar y sistematizar información científica internacional relacionada con: Sistemas alimentarios sostenibles, entornos alimentarios, sostenibilidad ambiental y alimentación y las experiencias de países que han desarrollado Guías Alimentarias Basadas en Sistemas Alimentarios Sostenibles. Identificar principios rectores, marco conceptual, enfoques y elementos metodológicos para la construcción de futuras Guías Alimentarias basadas en sistemas alimentarios sostenibles para el curso de vida, adaptadas al contexto boliviano. PRODUCTO 1.- 15 días calendario, 50% del monto total del contrato Plan de trabajo, metodología detallada, cronograma y diagnóstico técnico situacional. Esquema de documento base para la guías Alimentarias Sostenibles. Desarrollo y presentación del Plan de trabajo, metodología detallada y cronograma con el siguiente contenido mínimo: Metodología de trabajo y cocreación técnica Sistematización de información secundaria. Identificación de factores determinantes y brechas. PRODUCTO 2.- 55 días calendario, 50% del monto total del contrato Documento base de lineamientos técnicos y científicos para las guías alimentarias basadas en sistemas alimentarios sostenibles final aprobado técnicamente por la UAN. Descripción.- Elaboración del documento técnico base, con el siguiente contenido mínimo: Situación alimentaria y nutricional de Bolivia. Experiencias internacionales relevantes. Orientaciones metodológicas para las siguientes fases. Agenda de investigación para cubrir brechas de información. Socializar y consensuar el documento preliminar con el equipo de la UAN y ajustar el documento preliminar con base a observaciones y/o recomendaciones del equipo de la UAN y entrega del producto final. Diplomado(s) en una o más de las siguientes áreas: Alimentación Escolar, Gestión de Proyectos, Educación Alimentaria y Nutricional o áreas afines. Deseable maestría en Salud Pública, Programas y Proyectos Sociales, Seguridad Alimentaria y Nutricional, o áreas relacionadas. Mínimo al menos cinco (5) años de experiencia profesional en el área de nutrición, en una o más de las siguientes áreas: Planificación y gestión de intervenciones. Diseño y aplicación de investigación en salud y nutrición trabajo intersectorial con organismos de cooperación internacional. Alimentación escolar y nutrición pública. La selección final se basará en el principio de “mejor relación calidad-precio”, es decir, lograr el resultado deseado al costo más bajo posible. DOCUMENTACIÓN REQUERIDA PARA LA POSTULACIÓN: Propuesta económica en moneda local (bolivianos) expresada como monto total por la consultoría, incluyendo honorarios profesionales, emisión de factura, etc. No es necesario enviar propuesta técnica ni respaldo documental del CV. Tener nacionalidad boliviana o permiso para trabajar en territorio boliviano Conocimiento detallado de las condiciones socioeconómicas nacionales o locales. Consultores deben contar con su propio equipo, herramientas y materiales para desarrollar sus servicios. El acceso al email de UNICEF y a sus sistemas son restringidos. El candidato ganador del proceso deberá contar con un Seguro de Salud con cobertura de atención de consulta externa y hospitalización, UNICEF no tiene preferencia por ningún seguro en particular, puede ser público o privado, ser titular o beneficiario. Si el candidato no cuenta actualmente con un seguro de salud, es recomendable que incluya este costo en su presupuesto. Los candidatos seleccionados son los únicos responsables de garantizar que el visado (si aplicable) y el seguro médico necesarios para desempeñar las funciones del contrato sean válidos durante todo el período del contrato. CONSIDERACIONES ADMINISTRATIVAS IMPORTANTES: La emisión de factura es obligatoria por cada monto desembolsado. UNICEF solo recibe facturas emitidas por el consultor, no son recibidas facturas emitidas por otras personas o instituciones, tampoco formularios u otros descargos de pago de impuestos. Los consultores son responsables de cumplir con todas las obligaciones tributarias, de acuerdo con las leyes bolivianas y todas las normas aplicables. UNICEF promueve el cumplimiento de todas las leyes tributarias bolivianas relacionadas con la prestación de servicios de sus consultorías.
